en.title: Mermaid Live Editor
en.head_title: Mermaid Live Editor: draw diagrams online, export SVG and PNG
en.lede: Write Mermaid and the diagram draws as you type, then download it or copy it into a note.
en.description: A free Mermaid live editor in your browser: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, timelines, Gantt charts and more, with SVG and PNG export and links that carry the diagram.

zh.title: Mermaid 在线编辑器
zh.head_title: Mermaid 在线编辑器：在线画流程图、时序图，导出 SVG 和 PNG
zh.lede: 写 Mermaid 代码，图跟着实时画出来，画好了下载下来，或者复制进笔记里。
zh.description: 免费的 Mermaid 在线编辑器，在浏览器里实时画流程图、时序图、时间线和甘特图，可以导出 SVG、PNG，也能生成带着整张图的分享链接。

en.title: Markdown Table Generator
en.head_title: Markdown Table Generator: paste from Excel, CSV or Google Sheets
en.lede: Edit a table, or paste cells from Excel, Google Sheets, a CSV or a Markdown table, and copy the Markdown with its columns lined up.
en.description: A free Markdown table generator in your browser: paste from Excel, Google Sheets, CSV or TSV, set each column's alignment, and copy a pipe table with its columns lined up, Chinese and Japanese included.

zh.title: Markdown 表格生成器
zh.head_title: Markdown 表格生成器：Excel、CSV、Google Sheets 转 Markdown 表格
zh.lede: 在网格里编辑表格，或者直接粘贴 Excel、Google Sheets、CSV 和已有的 Markdown 表格，复制出来就是各列对齐的 Markdown。
zh.description: 免费的 Markdown 表格生成器，在浏览器里把 Excel、Google Sheets、CSV 或 TSV 转成 Markdown 表格，可以按列设置对齐，中文按两个字符宽对齐各列。

en.title: Markdown Viewer
en.head_title: Markdown Viewer Online: open .md files, save as PDF or HTML
en.lede: Open or paste Markdown and read it in MiaoYan's preview styling as you type, with math, code highlighting and Mermaid diagrams, then copy it with its styles or save it as PDF, HTML or Markdown.
en.description: A free online Markdown viewer and editor: open a .md file or paste text and read it with MiaoYan's preview styling, tables, task lists, math, code highlighting and Mermaid included, then copy it with inline styles or save as PDF, HTML or Markdown.

zh.title: Markdown 在线预览
zh.head_title: Markdown 在线预览：一键复制到公众号，存成 PDF 和 HTML
zh.lede: 打开或粘贴 Markdown，按妙言的预览样式实时显示，公式、代码和 Mermaid 图都会画出来，写完一键复制到公众号，也能存成 PDF、HTML 和 Markdown。
zh.description: 免费的 Markdown 在线预览和编辑，打开 .md 文件或粘贴文字，按妙言的预览样式显示表格、任务列表、公式、代码高亮和 Mermaid 图，带样式一键复制到公众号，也能存成 PDF、HTML 和 Markdown。

en.title: Markmap Editor
en.head_title: Markmap Editor Online: Markdown outline to mind map, PNG and SVG
en.lede: Write a Markdown outline and watch it grow into a mind map in MiaoYan's colours, fold and zoom it, then download it as PNG or SVG.
en.description: A free online Markmap editor: headings and nested lists become a mind map as you type, in MiaoYan's colours, with folding, zoom, and PNG or SVG download.

zh.title: Markmap 思维导图
zh.head_title: Markmap 在线编辑：Markdown 大纲生成思维导图，下载 PNG 和 SVG
zh.lede: 写一份 Markdown 大纲，右边按妙言的配色长成思维导图，可以收起分支和缩放，画好下载成 PNG 或 SVG。
zh.description: 免费的 Markmap 在线编辑器，Markdown 标题和列表边写边变成思维导图，用妙言的配色，可以收起、缩放，下载 PNG 和 SVG。

en.title: Chinese Typography Cleaner
en.head_title: Chinese Typography Cleaner: add spaces between Chinese and English
en.lede: Paste Chinese text or Markdown to add a space between Chinese and English or digits and fix half-width punctuation, with every change marked and code and links left alone.
en.description: A free online tool that adds spaces between Chinese characters and English letters or digits, turns half-width punctuation after Chinese into full-width and tidies ellipses and dashes, using the rules of MiaoYan's Clean Typography, without touching code, math or links.

zh.title: 中英文排版整理
zh.head_title: 中英文排版整理：中英文之间自动加空格，修正中文标点
zh.lede: 粘贴中文或 Markdown，自动在中英文、数字之间加空格，把中文后面的半角标点换成全角，改了哪里都会标出来，代码和链接不动。
zh.description: 免费的中英文排版整理工具，在浏览器里给中文和英文、数字之间加空格，把中文后面的半角标点换成全角，整理省略号和破折号，规则和妙言的清理排版一样，代码、公式和链接保持原样。

en.title: MiaoYan Theme for NetNewsWire
en.head_title: MiaoYan Theme for NetNewsWire: a calm reading theme for Chinese and English
en.lede: A reading theme for the NetNewsWire RSS reader, with looser line height and tracking for Chinese, blue links and a green accent, light and dark following the system, installed with one click.
en.description: A free, open source theme for NetNewsWire on Mac, iPhone and iPad that sets Chinese and English articles at a 1.7 line height with 0.5px tracking, keeps blue links and a green accent, follows the system's light and dark appearance and installs with one click.

zh.title: NetNewsWire 妙言主题
zh.head_title: NetNewsWire 妙言主题：给 RSS 阅读器换一套舒服的中文排版
zh.lede: RSS 阅读器 NetNewsWire 的一套阅读主题，中文的行距和字距调松了，链接蓝色、点缀绿色，跟着系统切换浅色和深色，点一下就能装上。
zh.description: 免费开源的 NetNewsWire 主题，Mac、iPhone 和 iPad 上都能用，正文行高 1.7、字距 0.5px，中文文章读起来不挤，链接蓝色、点缀绿色，跟着系统切换浅色和深色，一键安装。
